title: Do Not Subscribe
body: This is a scam! They take your money and won’t reply to any requests to cancel! I have sent numerous emails to cancel and get a refund but no replies. They don’t charge your itunes account like they stipulate but debit your credit card that i did not authorise so other than cancelling my credit card I don’t know how to stop payments and cancel subscription.
author: nc1974

title: no star
body:
i paid for a lifetime access at a discounted price here in facebook

but when i downloaded the app with the email add i used when i paid for it, it asks for payment for lifetime access at full price

i still didn’t receive any email of my plan or receipt as well
author: Sanders 1987

title: Biggest waste of money ever.
body:
This app is terrible! 

I’ve set tasks and reminders, and all I get is a notification each day to say I achieved nothing! And like an idiot, I fell for their ‘cheap lifetime’ thing  (that had to be accepted within a couple of minutes of launching the app) and paid for the lifetime! 

Don’t waste your time. It’s the worst app I’ve ever been dumb enough to pay for.
author: Sam from QLD, Australia

title: Mel
body: Disappointing. Firstly, I was charged $80 and after sending an email for a refund and receiving not even an acknowledgement I decided to review it. You really can’t do anything on the app without purchasing the premium and even then it’s pretty basic. The reminders don’t work either. Better off to buy a journal. Deleting the app, waste of money 👎
author: ukmiss

title: Rubbish
body: Not worth it at all. Forces you to subscribe straight up. Nothing like it presented to be!!
author: Nosleepnudge

title: Can’t try you have to buy
body: Average set up
author: vivalaesther

title: Not what I thought
body: I don’t enjoy the layout and only got it because the cleaning checklist advertised on Instagram looked amazing and I thought that’s the type of content I’d be paying for, that list is nowhere to be found and there is nothing of value IMO
author: Theothersara

title: It’s not free to use
body: You can’t do anything. hate these apps that say they’re free and they’re not.
author: Sassyfeedback

title: Not a great start
body:
I paid for the full product and it was debited to my account then I proceed and then when I enter the app see an ad for 1/2 price life-time access ad get slot machine pop-up adverts as well. 
Not a great start at all.
author: reets67

title: Not worth it
body: There are hundreds of thousands of resources out there that are completely free and do exactly the same thing. After reading the other reviews I would assume you don’t even get your money’s worth and they’ve charged people twice and been extremely hard to contact for a refund. Please be smart and don’t waste your money on apps like this!
author: azeter

title: Annoyingly overcome with ads
body: I haven’t even started a challenge yet and I’ve been asked 100 times to subscribe and have watched multiple ads. So annoying
author: Rhi72

title: Very Disappointed
body: I expected a lot more content in this app for the price I paid. Very disappointed to say the least.  I’d like a refund.
author: kinsy79

title: Charged Twice
body:
Absolute waste of money. Charged twice for premium access. The second charge offered nothing new or extra.
Considering conversion to $AUS not remotely worth it
author: M4M4M4MO

title: It’s a no from me
body: I was paying for premium and I couldn’t even access full premium features on the app.
author: EmilyBenov

title: Disappointed
body: It’s not what it says it is and there are things advertised that after they screwed you for a subscription aren’t there. Don’t be fooled. I’d really like the developers to contact me since I can’t find how to contact them. I’d like my money back
author: Cathharris

title: Stupidly expensive
body: Even if you pay for premium you then need to pay an additional $16 per month to access further content. Too expensive to even warrant trying the app. HabitMinder is much cheaper and better!
author: Paul Pros

title: good concept but needs refining
body: love the concept of this app but the habit notifications are sent at the complete wrong time which unfortunately renders the app useless to me
author: dansta3600

title: Notifications
body: Setting up notifications, the timing of habits and how frequently they should recur would seem pretty fundamental to this sort of app. But I’m yet to receive a notification from it to remind me to log a streak. Nor is how to set that up intuitive
author: A OJ

title: Trash
body: Trash app stole money from you pocket by forciing you with subscription
author: Sondoha

title: Needs work
body:
Firstly, I didn’t like the fact that the app immediately wanted me to purchase of subscription without even being able to see if I like it.
Would also like the ability to tell the app if I am male and single - a number of the challenges appear to be aimed females and/or those in a relationship.
author: Kyi561

title: This app is amazing!
body: I never had a app like this before! You can try new challenges which is amazing and try new things. But the only thing I don’t like about this app is it’s premium . I would prefer put the premium section away, but overall it’s amazing! Thank u so much!
author: Sophienour

title: Nothing As Presented
body: In ads this app seems easy to use and is made by the app. Once downloaded it tries to convince you to buy a completely unnecessary ‘subscription’. You have to create your habits instead of the app giving them to you. It tells you a couple of things such as taking a cold shower. Personally, I think this app is as good as making a list of things on notes or a piece of paper.
author: Hhheeeeeeeyyyyyyyyyy

title: Misleading Ads
body: Thanks for the misleading ads on socials. Ads show mental health challenges and tasks which are not represented on the app. Thanks for taking money and failing to produce.
author: JNChristian
